summary: Terry Kishiyama and his wife and two small children (ages 5 and 1) were cut off by floodwaters at their home just outside Lyons; they hiked to a neighbor's house on higher ground, waited several days for rescue, then were airlifted by a military helicopter Saturday morning
notes: Flood-stage creek washed away the family's drinking well and land; family shared a single toothbrush while waiting; child waved an orange T-shirt at the helicopter across the river
